meta.title: Biohazard Remediation Rockville MD | Black Ops
meta.description: GBAC trained biohazard remediation across Rockville and Montgomery County. Answered 24 hours, unmarked vehicles, written price before work starts.

banner.subhead: Blood, bodily fluids, sharps and contamination, removed and decontaminated to a documented standard. We answer at any hour and we are usually on site within two hours. Our vehicles carry no company signage.

problem.heading: What people are usually facing when they call
problem.lead: Biohazard is a broad word for a narrow problem: something has contaminated a property and it cannot safely be cleaned by whoever normally cleans it.

items.title: Assessment and containment
items.body: The affected area is isolated before anything is touched, with negative air where the contamination warrants it.

items.title: Removal of contaminated material
items.body: Porous material that cannot be safely decontaminated is removed and documented rather than cleaned in place.

items.title: Decontamination
items.body: Hospital grade disinfection of every affected surface, following CDC and EPA disinfection guidance.

items.title: Sharps and regulated waste
items.body: Collected, transported and disposed of through a licensed medical waste stream, with the manifest handed to you.

items.title: Odour treatment at source
items.body: Treated at the source rather than masked, where it applies.

items.title: Written clearance
items.body: Confirmation that the area is safe to use again, in writing, on completion.

process.heading: What happens, and how long each part takes
process.note: Slot, verify every timescale against the client's real jobs before publishing.

steps.title: Your call
steps.body: The address, how to get in, and roughly what has happened. That is all we need to mobilise.

steps.title: On site assessment
steps.body: Unmarked vehicle. We scope the contamination and give you a written price before any work begins.

steps.title: Containment
steps.body: Isolating before cleaning is what stops a small problem becoming a whole building problem.

steps.title: Remediation
steps.body: Depends entirely on how far the contamination has travelled.

steps.title: Documentation and clearance
steps.body: Written clearance, the disposal manifest, and photographs.

credentials.heading: Why we are allowed to do this work
credentials.note: This is not general cleaning, and the difference is not marketing. It is training, insurance and a licensed disposal route.

items.name: GBAC trained
items.detail: The Global Biorisk Advisory Council, now a division of ISSA. Certificate number, slot.

items.name: ISSA CMI
items.detail: The Cleaning Management Institute, the industry's training body. Membership number, slot.

items.name: OSHA bloodborne pathogen compliant
items.detail: Not a certificate anyone issues, a standard every technician is trained against. Written exposure control plan on request.

items.name: Licensed and insured in Maryland
items.detail: General liability and workers compensation. Licence number and limits, slot.

items.name: Veteran owned and federally registered

disclaimer.heading: One thing we will not do
disclaimer.body: We do not display CDC, EPA or OSHA seals to imply those agencies endorse us. They do not endorse anyone. We follow CDC and EPA disinfection guidance and our technicians are trained to the OSHA bloodborne pathogen standard. Those are facts, and they are worth more than a logo. If another company shows you federal seals, ask them what they mean.

pricing.heading: What this costs, and how you find out
pricing.note: We do not publish prices for this work, because the range is too wide to be useful. Two jobs that sound the same on the phone can differ by a factor of ten once we see them, and quoting either one blind would be guessing. We come out, assess the property, and give you a written price before any work starts. That visit costs nothing and puts you under no obligation.
pricing.footnote: The number will not change once the job is underway, unless we find something behind a wall that nobody could have seen. If that happens we stop, show you, and re-quote before continuing.

items.a: Blood and bodily fluids, sharps, sewage, decomposition, and anything contaminated by them. The practical test is simpler: if cleaning it would put an untrained person at risk of infection, it is our work rather than a cleaner's.

items.q: Can my regular cleaning company not do this?
items.a: No, and they should not try. It needs bloodborne pathogen training, the right personal protective equipment, and a licensed medical waste disposal route. Most janitorial contracts specifically exclude it.

items.q: Are you available at night and at weekends?
items.a: Our phone is answered 24 hours a day, including weekends and holidays. On site, we are usually with you within two hours anywhere in Montgomery County, and faster in Rockville, Bethesda and Silver Spring because we are based on Talbott Street rather than driving in from another county.
No. Our response vehicles carry no company signage.

items.q: Do you work for businesses as well as homes?
items.a: Yes, and roughly half of this work in Rockville is commercial. Labs, medical practices, dental suites and shared facilities on the I-270 corridor. We document to the standard your inspection needs, not just to your insurer's.

A written scope before work starts, the regulated waste disposal manifest, written clearance on completion, and photographs throughout. That set is what insurers, inspectors and estate solicitors ask for.

items.q: Is there a certification I should look for?
items.a: GBAC training and OSHA bloodborne pathogen compliance, plus current Maryland licensing and insurance. There is no state biohazard licence in Maryland, so any company implying one exists is worth a second look.

items.q: How do I know the area is genuinely safe afterwards?
items.a: We issue written clearance. For commercial work we can arrange third party verification where your protocol requires it.

items.q: Do you remove and replace the flooring and drywall?
items.a: We remove what has to come out. Rebuilding is a separate trade, and we will tell you honestly what is needed rather than quoting for work we do not do.
We do not publish ranges, because two jobs that sound identical on the phone can differ by a factor of ten. We assess at no charge and give you a written price before any work starts.

cta.heading: Call, and we will tell you what is involved
cta.body: No obligation. Give us the address and how to get in. We will tell you what is involved, roughly what it costs, and what your insurer is likely to cover.

form.heading: Request a discreet call back
form.body: We call you. No signage, no questions on the doorstep.
